scope: Every bundled DeviceLibrary table; Apple public product specifications, EU product information sheets and locally installed Apple-signed Xcode/CoreSimulator metadata. No AppleDB or libirecovery values are classified as Apple-official evidence.
importantLimitations: EU product information sheets state rated capacity, not necessarily firmware DesignCapacity. A numeric difference alone does not prove that a historical design-capacity reference must be migrated.
Wh values were preserved as Wh; no conversion to mAh was made without an official matching rated voltage.
An official product name/A-model listing does not directly prove every internal hardware identifier or regional identifier tuple.
Simulator productClass was not substituted for physical BoardConfig.
Model spelling/marketing suffixes, generation language, storage options and GPS/Cellular grouping were normalized for identity comparison.

existingThirdPartyBoardDifferences.note: Previously corroborated against libirecovery and AppleDB, kept separate from Apple-official verification.

regionSelectionObservation.observedBehavior: Only exact productSku CH/A and ZP/A select physicalSIM; all other/missing values select esim.
regionSelectionObservation.existingPhysicalSIMCapacityTable: Values for iPhone 17, 17e, 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max, 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max match reviewed EU physical-SIM rated capacities.
regionSelectionObservation.reviewNeeded: Existing physicalSIM/eSIM categories should be retained. The region/model resolution and HK/CN display label require separate review for physical-SIM models sold in other regions.

migrationDesignRequestedByUser.status: Design note only; no implementation in this audit
migrationDesignRequestedByUser.purpose: Centralize DeviceLibrary data correction rules; CoreData (iOS 16) and SwiftData (iOS 17+) execute the rules in their respective migration files.
constraints: Exclude the approved Duo direct edit.
Keep migration code out of ordinary lookup and record-save implementations.
Do not infer historical device identity from possibly incorrect legacy manual model codes.
Preserve explicit user profiles, measurements, physical IDs and record IDs.
Re-evaluate late imports and cloud arrivals idempotently.

xcodeEvidence.batteryCapacityResult: No rated/design/nominal mAh constants found in reviewed plist/JSON/deviceinfo files. The gas-gauge-battery capability is Boolean simulator capability metadata, not a battery capacity.
